SHARED COORDINATE SYSTEM:
All players use the same coordinate notation: (Rr,Cc) where r is the row number (1–8, top to bottom) and c is the column number (1–8, left to right). For example, (R3,C5) is row 3, column 5. Before every move you must send your teammates a short broadcast message (at most 100 words). It will be shown to every teammate on their next turn.
